svg.aria-label: Ogmios. Speak English freely, learn from it after. You speak into the microphone; a laptop running Ogmios shows the conversation, A small win at work, where the partner answers without correcting you. Then three cards come out: your focus, I did a big effort becomes I made a big effort; a word from your book, tumble, with Alice's own line; and the day it comes back, in 1 day.

text.tspan: A free computer app. Talk with Claude, then
get one thing to work on, in your language.
